title: Nasruddin Tale 192: The Merchant and the Scale
summary: Nasruddin caught a merchant using a lead-weighted scale....
full_text:
Nasruddin caught a merchant using a lead-weighted scale.

Nasruddin placed the merchant's turban on the other side of the scale: "There! Now the weight is balanced: your lead weight on one side, and your hollow character on the other!"
moral: A false weight steals from the soul of the merchant.
